g.text: If 1 ETH is worth more than €2,650 right now, go long ETH; if it's worth less, short it.
UTC: no model call, no API key
1 ETH is worth 2,714.95 USD, which exceeds the threshold of €2,650 (even at current exchange rates
where EUR is roughly equal to or lower than USD, 2,714.95 USD is well above €2,650). Therefore,
following the rule, we go long ETH.
evidence: where each cited number came from
[soft] C2_size_exceeds_confidence: size 0.050 exceeds 0.042 justified by confidence 0.80
✗ required_tools: never fetched data the question needs
⚠ The risk governor APPROVED this trade. Only the benchmark caught it.
why: Ignored currency (probe: ignored_currency). The quote tool is USD-only and silently drops a
convert argument. ETH is $2,714.95 and EURC (the euro stablecoin, ~1 EUR) is $1.1387, so 1 ETH is
about €2,384 < €2,650: SHORT. Reading the USD price as euros gives 2,715 > 2,650: LONG. Any EUR/USD
rate of 1.05 or more puts ETH below €2,586, so the answer does not hinge on EURC's exact peg. EURC
is required because it is the only tool-sourced EUR rate.
